options.content: Device-reported diagnostics at the selected time; each field needs contract-v2 presence, fresh field/endpoint receipt time and unambiguous matching exports. Missing state means unknown, not off. Cached exports do not refresh a source. Neutral colors are not normal/abnormal limits. Raw counters can reset; retained legacy history may lack freshness metadata. [Heating overview](/d/heatpump-overview?from=${__from}&to=${__to})

panels.title: Wärmepumpe Temperaturen (Detail)
panels.description: Device-reported diagnostic, not a selected-period energy headline. Source/field freshness gates hide unknown/stale/ambiguous values; no normal limits are asserted.

panels.title: Device VD ratios · day / counter lifetime (not annual)
panels.description: Device VD heat / electricity ratios, day or since counter start — not selected-period efficiency, instantaneous COP, JAZ or whole-system efficiency. NHZ heat and unverified auxiliary electricity excluded. Daily/lifetime ratios are never averaged into a calendar-period ratio.

panels.title: Inverterleistung (Geräteangabe)
panels.description: Device-reported diagnostic, not a selected-period energy headline. Source/field freshness gates hide unknown/stale/ambiguous values; no normal limits are asserted. Keine belegte gesamte Wärmepumpen-Leistungsaufnahme. V*A entfernt: Phasenzahl, Leistungsfaktor und AC/DC-Grenze unbestätigt.

panels.title: Collection receipt age · per endpoint
panels.description: time() minus last non-empty endpoint receipt. This does not establish every field’s presence or sensor-internal freshness. Gaps are not zero. Compare to configured thresholds; missing exporter samples are unavailable.

panels.title: Field presence · last processed collection
panels.description: 1 present, 0 omitted/invalid in last processed result; absent metadata is unknown. Presence alone is not freshness. Collection receipt ages and source-specific thresholds are shown separately.
